The district court consolidated the actions, and in October 2021, dismissed the consolidated action without prejudice. Plaintiffs filed an amended consolidated complaint, which the Company moved to dismiss. In October 2022, the court granted the Company's motion to dismiss with prejudice. Plaintiffs have appealed this decision to the Second Circuit. The Company also received a related document request pursuant to ERISA § 104(b), to which the Company has responded. The Company and its current and former officers and directors are defending themselves against these claims. These protests may result in awards to the Company being reversed, delayed, or modified.
